name: Easy Cabbage Roll Casserole with Ground Beef, Rice, Tomato, Mozzarella & Sour Cream

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry cabbage; halve lengthwise, cut out the core, and slice crosswise into 1-inch thick wedges. Transfer to a large baking dish, drizzle with oil, and season with spices. Stir to coat and spread out in an even layer. Place baking dish in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until cabbage is tender, 15-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ small head green cabbage
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp paprika
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, preheat a large pot over medium-high heat. While the pot heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, beef, garlic, sugar, and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
680 g lean ground beef
2 tsp minced garlic
2 tsp granulated sugar
1 tsp paprika
1 tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper
½ tsp parsley flakes
⅛ tsp thyme, dried

instructions.primary_message: Add tomato sauce and diced tomatoes to the pot, then bring to a simmer. Once the meat sauce is simmering, reduce heat to low and simmer until the cabbage is done roasting.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (425 g) can tomato sauce
1 (411 g) can diced tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: When the cabbage is done, add meat sauce and rice to the baking dish, then stir to combine (making sure to break up the cabbage leaf clusters). Sprinkle the casserole with cheese and tightly cover with aluminum foil. Return to the oven and bake for 20 minutes. Remove foil and continue to bake until sauce is bubbling and cheese is melted, 20 minutes more. Remove from oven.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (240 g) pouch basmati rice, pre-cooked
1 cup mozzarella cheese, shredded

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide casserole between plates or bowls and top with sour cream. Enjoy!
